resetPassword.subject: Reset your password - M'ARTE
resetPassword.message: Someone recently requested a password change for your M'ARTE account. If this was you, you can set a new password here:
resetPassword.ignore: If you don't want to change your password or didn't request this, just ignore and delete this message.
resetPassword.security: To keep your account secure, please don't forward this email to anyone.

verifyEmail.subject: Welcome to M'Arte — confirm your email
verifyEmail.preview: One last step to activate your M'Arte account.
verifyEmail.heading: Welcome to M'Arte
verifyEmail.message: Thank you for joining M'Arte. Each of our pieces is crafted by hand in our Warsaw atelier, and it is a pleasure to welcome you. To complete your registration and secure your account, please confirm your email address below.
verifyEmail.expiry: For your security, this link will expire in 60 minutes.
verifyEmail.ignore: If this message reached you by mistake, you may simply disregard it — no account will be created.

changeEmail.subject: Verify your new email address - M'ARTE
changeEmail.message: You recently requested to change the email address associated with your M'ARTE account. Please verify your new email address to complete the process.
changeEmail.ignore: If you didn't request this change, please ignore this email and your account will remain secure.
